dedupe_keys.name: aldrans office window opening and indoor climate measurements 2020 2022

description: This deposit contains four CSV collections from a strongly daylit open-plan office at Bartenbach in Aldrans, Austria. The building-environment researchers recorded indoor temperature and relative humidity, outdoor temperature, roof wind speed and window-opening events to support building-energy analysis. Temperature, humidity and wind values were logged each minute; window states were logged when they changed. Most series cover September 2020–August 2022, while wind measurements begin in July 2021. Mendeley version 2 is freely available under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is limited to one working office, and the shorter wind record prevents a complete common two-year series across all variables. Sensor placement and daylight conditions also limit transfer to other buildings. A reviewer-assessed use is testing occupancy-dependent natural ventilation or indoor-temperature simulations. model-energyplus is a related building simulator, but no weather conversion, parameter fit or model validation was performed. The metadata and article were read without downloading the measurements.
name: Aldrans office window-opening and indoor climate measurements, 2020–2022
